name: Italian open-system barriers: Milan ring roads
law: A fixed toll to the user per passage by class (A, B by height for two axles; 3, 4, 5 by axles), VAT included, from 1 January 2025. Milano Serravalle - Milano Tangenziali's tolls at the barriers of its semi-closed ring roads: A50 Tangenziale Ovest di Milano, Terrazzano barrier class 5 EUR 8.20; A51 Tangenziale Est di Milano, Vimercate barrier (Agrate Brianza) class 5 EUR 4.90; A52 Tangenziale Nord di Milano, Sesto San Giovanni barrier class 5 EUR 6.30. The ring roads' other km carry no toll; the barrier tolls include Autostrade per l'Italia's share where the table gives one. Each barrier is placed at the toll point Autostrade per l'Italia's station file gives it (Milano Serravalle's Vimercate barrier is the A51's toll gate at Agrate Brianza, km 19.5).
